scenes.text: Identify, explain and apply the important ideas behind being kind with technology.
Ask permission: is important before using another person's device. Private details: should not be shared with strangers.
Kind language: makes digital communication respectful. Trusted adult: can help with worrying online contact. Strong password: protects an account from unwanted entry.
Use an imaginary example or a teacher-approved offline screenshot. Discuss when to use ask permission and private details. Never enter a real password or share private details in this activity.
